name: play
description: Plays a track immediately (clears the queue). Resolves plain text search queries or plays from local cache. Pass the user's requested song title/artist directly.

query.description: A plain text search query (e.g., 'Rick Astley Never Gonna Give You Up' or 'classical jazz').

name: play_next
description: Queues a track at the very front of the queue to be played immediately after the current song finishes.

query.description: A plain text search query (e.g., 'Blinding Lights').

name: resume
description: Resumes current media playback if paused. I user says only play not any song name then also you can execute this command.

name: stop
description: Stops all playback and fully clears the playback state, queue, and autoplay pool.

name: next
description: Skips the current track and advances to the next track in the queue or autoplay pool.

name: previous
description: Returns playback to the previous track from history.

name: seek
description: Seeks to a specific position in seconds within the current track.

seconds.description: Position in seconds to seek to.

name: volume
description: Adjusts the volume level of the player.

name: mute
description: Toggles the mute state on or off.

name: autoplay
description: Enables or disables autoplay recommendations when the manual queue runs dry.

enabled.description: Set to true to enable autoplay, or false to disable it.

name: write_file
description: Writes text content to a local file on the device SD Card storage.

path.description: Absolute file path on SD Card starting with /sdcard/ (e.g., /sdcard/notes.txt).

content.description: Text content to write into the file.

name: read_file
description: Reads text content from a local file on the device SD Card storage.

path.description: Absolute file path on SD Card starting with /sdcard/ (e.g., /sdcard/notes.txt).

name: restart_websocket_client
description: Reinitializes and restarts the Gemini voice assistant WebSocket connection.

name: set_device_volume
description: Sets the physical hardware speaker volume level.

name: set_led_strip
description: Configures the solid status color of the RGB LED ring (for system idle states).

name: mqtt_forward
description: Forwards data/message payload to a custom MQTT topic.

topic.description: MQTT topic name to publish to.

name: stop_active_alarm
description: Stops any active playing alarm tone on the device.

name: set_alarm
description: Sets or schedules an alarm on the device at a specific absolute hour and minute (24-hour format).

hour.description: Hour of the day in 24-hour format (0-23).

tone_file.description: Path to the WAV sound file on the SD card (optional, defaults to /sdcard/alarms/soft_wake_up.wav).

enabled.description: Whether the alarm is enabled (optional, defaults to true).
